2115214294610591793.en_summary: BREAKING: The 3-month correlation between Apple, $AAPL, and the Nasdaq 100 is down to -0.12, turning negative for the first time on record in data going back to the early 1980s. The correlation between $AAPL and the Nasdaq 100 has now remained negative for 2 consecutive months. This comes as $AAPL has gained +9.7% over this period, while the Nasdaq 100 has increased just +0.2%. By comparison, in June 2025, the 3-month correlation stood at +0.90, as Apple and other technology stocks rallied together. From 2006 through 2025, the correlation never fell below +0.30. The divergence between Apple and the rest of the tech sector is unprecedented.

2115209843934142968.en_summary: $GEV gas turbine book has grown from 50 GW to 116 GW in just five quarters while production slot reservations have tripled to 63 GW. Customers are now paying deposits just to get in line which tells you how tight the race to secure power for AI data centers has become. (Quoted: Data centers now take about a fifth of $GEV's gas turbine book. The company expects to be mostly sold out through 2030 at its year-end target. As a result, first-half 2026 orders were priced over 20% above those of late 2025. Its 3Q report, out tomorrow Oct 28, will show how close it is to that target.)

2115204060798136464.en_summary: I spent the weekend pushing the new Siri and am happy to report it's leap forward. But once you've used personal agents, you ask Siri to do things it can't. That begs the question; Which is harder to copy: Apple's ecosystem or a great personal agent? I used to think the ecosystem. Now I'm not so sure. $AAPL reports next Monday. The most important topic is the shifting AI goal posts. In June the conversations was around was when will the new Siri come out. Now it's what's their answer to Muse, Grok Bot and Dots.
2115204060798136464.zh_summary: 我週末一直在推進新 Siri，很高興報告它是一個飛躍。但一旦你使用過個人代理，你會要求 Siri 做它做不到的事情。這引出問題：哪個更難複製：蘋果的生態系統還是一個優秀的個人代理？我以前認為是生態系統。現在我不那麼確定了。$AAPL 下週一報告。最重要的話題是移動的 AI 目標線。6 月的對話圍繞新 Siri 何時推出。現在是他們對 Muse、Grok Bot 和 Dots 的答案是什麼。
